_comment: What players take from each other and from the world. All damage is a fraction of full health (1.0 = all of it). pvp: a round from another player does body or head, times the round's damage kind (see 'damage' on each element in elements.json); knockback is the shove in m/s. friendlyFire false makes players' rounds pass through each other (the host can change it in play). burnPerSecond: standing in a fire patch or an inferno. etherealScale: a haze round passes through a player and does this share of a normal round, without the shove. ghostfirePerSecond: caught in a breath of ghostfire (it lasts half a second). strikeDamage: a thunderstrike at its centre, falling off to nothing at its edge. revive: a teammate within range holds interact for time seconds; you get up with that much health. With everyone down, all come to back at the start. arenaHatLead: in an arena match, a player this many kills ahead of everyone else wears the cowboy hat and poncho. stealth: how far ghosts can see you crouched (or sliding) and crawling, as a share of their sight range.
